0.0: Hi everyone, today I want to talk about why our database queries got slow
7.5: It started when the table crossed fifty million rows
15.0: The planner switched from an index scan to a sequential scan
22.5: We found the statistics were stale, so we ran analyze
30.0: That fixed half of the queries but not the reports
37.5: The reports sorted by a column without an index
45.0: Adding a composite index cut the report time from forty seconds to two
52.5: Then we partitioned the table by month
60.0: Partitioning made vacuum faster and backups smaller
67.5: The lesson: measure first, then index, then partition
75.0: Thanks for watching
